operations.rationale: Two proceedings were marked as the final domestic decision: doc:constitutional_court_application_2017 and doc:proc_general_assembly_20150707. The facts show the applicant lodged an individual application with the Constitutional Court on 11 September 2017 and the Constitutional Court later declared that application inadmissible on 23 May 2018: "Noting that the applicant’s application had been submitted on 11 September 2017, after the expiry of the time-limit, the Constitutional Court declared the application inadmissible." Because the Constitutional Court decision is the last domestic decision before the Strasbourg application, doc:proc_general_assembly_20150707 should not be marked as the final domestic decision. Accordingly, remove its true value and set it to false.
